finding: The configured stock-opencode entrypoint rendered the entire materialized manuscript into stdin instead of creating the preregistered isolated Git manuscript workspace. It also could not observe file or Git mutations.
impact: A sealed run would have measured prompt-fed model behavior rather than stock OpenCode as ordinarily used and would have underreported unauthorized changes.
disposition: Supersede authoritative run freeze revision 1 before any sealed execution. Evaluation commit a1ad033cf8509a1f679e7269be51387985238d25 writes plain bounded chapters to a fresh Git repository, sends only the public request and authority, captures passage/file/marker/HEAD mutations, and deletes the workspace after each cell. The frozen Writer candidate is unchanged.
regressionTests: packages/writer-bench/src/stock-opencode.test.ts: materializes stock OpenCode context as a plain isolated Git manuscript
packages/writer-bench/src/stock-opencode.test.ts: stock OpenCode receives the public request and workspace affordance but not manuscript text
packages/writer-bench/src/stock-opencode.test.ts: captures passage mutations, added files, and commits as baseline edit artifacts
packages/writer-bench/src/stock-opencode.test.ts: fails closed on damaged passage markers

finding: The revision 3 adapter retained total Writer usage but discarded existing context-selection and execution progress events, so the preregistered phase-level cost and latency report could not be produced. Its source receipt method was also not explicit about Git blob bytes versus platform-dependent working-tree serialization, and no single fail-closed command audited every frozen gate.
impact: An otherwise complete run could omit required phase evidence or be accepted through an incomplete manual gate review.
disposition: Supersede revision 3 before accepting any model output. Evaluation commit 1f8228a0335b552cd0156d5ed587b5b579b016fd derives selector and execution usage from existing progress events without changing model behavior, audits every frozen reliability, safety, comparison, usage, cache, and phase-total gate, and defines SHA-256 receipts over exact Git blob bytes. The candidate, prompts, tasks, context policy, scoring, targets, model settings, resume cells, and human-review selection are unchanged.
regressionTests: packages/writer-bench/src/production-writer.test.ts: executes the shipped Writer command protocol against an isolated manuscript workspace
packages/writer-bench/src/production-writer.test.ts: derives phase usage from progress events without double-counting selector work
packages/writer-bench/src/book-scale-audit.test.ts: audits every frozen reliability, safety, telemetry, and comparison gate
packages/writer-bench/src/book-scale-audit.test.ts: fails closed on missing phase, raw cache, metric, or reliability evidence
